recommendation: Govern codes as lexical identifiers, preserve displayed source notation, and prohibit vector-wide numeric formatting.

finding: Literal NA is emitted as semantic property values.
recommendation: Normalize source sentinels to null while preserving raw provenance.

finding: All 405 source hierarchy edges become skos:broader.
recommendation: Use collections for navigation and approve broader only after extensional identity review.

finding: Parent nodes are minted from label plus parent and sometimes duplicate child labels.
recommendation: Collapse duplicates and review remaining groups as concepts versus collections.

finding: Pilot mints parallel identities despite legacy ERA mappings and exact AOM label-definition matches.
recommendation: Reuse stable AOM IDs only after row-level identity and module review.

finding: Practice identity, absence, baseline, comparator, and treatment semantics share one hierarchy.
recommendation: Separate practice concepts, application occurrences, conditions, and experimental roles.

finding: Reporting levels, property identity, units, derivation flags, and interpretation metadata share one concept tree.
recommendation: Use SOSA Property, procedure, quantity/unit/basis, derivation, and reporting collections.

finding: Linked.Tab and Linked.Col are published without a field-key contract.
recommendation: Keep as source provenance until ADR 0052 field registry and binding rules are accepted.

finding: One practice status is blank and deprecated rows can still receive pilot concepts.
